description: Use this when the user asks about a data-center market (metro supply, operators, pipeline, pricing): facility count, tracked MW, status mix, top providers, recent facilities or lease pricing. Pass market as a slug (e.g. northern-virginia). Returns stats, by_status, top_providers, recent_facilities, market_pricing (quote its basis). Verdict: use get_market_dcpi_rank. Keyless: a trimmed preview; a free key gets more. Ex: "1 MW colo price in Los Angeles?" Get the market slug from rank_markets or get_market_dcpi_rank; 404 = unrecognised market, use one of those slugs.

compare_to.description: Optional second market slug to compare against, e.g. dallas

market.description: Market slug (metro), e.g. northern-virginia, dallas, frankfurt, singapore — valid slugs come from rank_markets / get_market_dcpi_rank

metric.description: Optional single metric to focus on, e.g. vacancy, pricing, absorption, pipeline

mpp_credential.description: Per-call payment (Stripe MPP): the Shared Payment Token for challenges[0]; pays that challenge for this one call. Send it only with your human's explicit approval of the charge.

mpp_pay.description: Per-call payment quote (Stripe MPP): true returns a signed payment challenge instead of the free preview; no money moves. Set it only after your human has explicitly approved paying for this call.

period.description: Optional time window for the metric, e.g. ttm, 12mo, ytd

name: get_market_intel
title: Market Intelligence
